objective: Public visual-model TensorRT deployment, integrated bounded dataflow and reproducible B1 handoff before user-led optimization

architecture.inference: In-process TensorRT for every deployed visual neural network
architecture.application: Reuse the existing application and pinned upstream components; scene-specific adapters only
architecture.reference: PyTorch, ONNX Runtime or OpenCV may be used as explicit validation references, never a silent production inference fallback

modules.capability: Calibrated stereo disparity and metric depth with validity
Person/object boxes, classes, scores and instance masks
Public model body/hand keypoints with explicit topology, confidence and coordinate semantics
Face boxes, confidence and five landmarks
Head orientation with documented axes and units
Gaze direction with documented axes and units
Face alignment, embedding, registered identity matching and unknown result
Person appearance features and bounded target association
Object features and measured association cases, not a claim of universal instance recognition
The public model's documented expression scores
Wave greeting and stationary open-palm full-turn cancellation

gates.name: Pinned sources, weights, license and interface contracts
Stereo and whole-body pose conversion/reference feasibility
Per-model TensorRT execution and reference parity
Shared frame provenance, ROI transforms, distance gates and target association
Bounded resource ownership, stale data, cancellation and recovery
Fixed-input and live-camera functional acceptance with explicit coverage
Frozen B1 module/pipeline/coexistence measurements and raw evidence
Startup, architecture, diagnostics and user profiling handoff

contract_requirements: Repository commit, weight checksum and license scope
Input names, shapes, dtype, color, normalization and crop/resize transform
Output topology, confidence semantics, coordinate frame, units and invalid markers
Frame-group id, source epoch, timestamps, target id and expiry
Trigger/exit conditions, rates, maximum targets, queues and inference instances
Reference-parity method, functional fixtures and acceptance thresholds fixed before measurement
deferred_contracts: Original proprietary 70/52 keypoint indexing and exact output equivalence
The complete original ten-class gesture classifier
completion_rule: Every locked in-scope module and gate requires inspected real evidence; interfaces, empty placeholders or server startup alone do not prove completion. Handoff B1 then wait for user-led optimization.
measurement_rule: Preserve B0; measure actual performance without promising all models at 30 FPS. Separate model changes from same-model optimization, reference validation from production inference, and fixed/public replay from real-person quality qualification.
